testing.spec_coverage_estimate: <5% (mostly skeleton specs from Angular CLI scaffolding)

npm.start: npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev

guards.name: authGuard
guards.logic: await auth.waitForSession(); if no user → redirect to /login

guards.name: guestGuard
guards.logic: await auth.waitForSession(); if user present → redirect to /dashboard

guards.name: betaAccessGuard
guards.logic: if !environment.requiresBetaAccess → allow; else if !betaAccess.hasAccess() → redirect to /beta-access
guards.security_note: Code check is client-side only. localStorage flag can be set manually by anyone via DevTools. Not a security boundary — only a friction filter.

core_services.name: SupabaseService
core_services.role: Singleton wrapper around @supabase/supabase-js client + global refresh bus

exposes.refreshAll$: Observable<void> — emits when any service needs to broadcast refresh
exposes.triggerRefreshAll(): Pushes a refresh signal that PropertyService and TenantService subscribe to

core_services.name: AuthService
core_services.side_effects: Subscribes to onAuthStateChange and writes to signals; lazily fetches `profiles.full_name` to derive userName

core_services.name: PropertyService
methods: loadProperties()  — selects with nested tenants(name, rent_status, rent_due_date, rent_amount, lease_start_date, lease_end_date)
loadPayments()  — payments WHERE property_id IN owned property IDs
core_services.initial_load_pattern: Constructor calls loadProperties().then(loadPayments) — silent refresh after first authenticated fetch

core_services.name: TenantService
methods: loadTenants()  — tenants INNER JOIN properties on properties.owner_id = auth user
deleteTenant(id)  — also nulls properties.tenant and sets status='vacant', then triggerRefreshAll()

core_services.name: BetaAccessService
core_services.security_caveat: Stored under localStorage['propza_beta_access']='granted'. Comparator is base64, NOT a hash. Bypassable via DevTools.

core_services.name: RentDueService
core_services.purpose: Centralized, timezone-safe (ZA UTC+2) rent status calculation. Pure functions on tenants + payments.

status_rules.vacant: lease hasn't started OR has ended

key_methods: mapToDatabaseStatus(status)  — collapses to DB-allowed values: paid|overdue|upcoming|vacant

core_services.name: RentHelperService
core_services.purpose: Legacy/parallel rent calculations. Supports BOTH monthly and weekly billing.
core_services.architectural_concern: Two rent calculation services with overlapping responsibilities. Components inconsistently use one or the other (sometimes both). Consolidation needed.

core_services.name: TranslationService
core_services.structure: Single object literal mapping key → { en, af, zu, xh }
core_services.improvement_opportunity: Externalize to per-language JSON files loaded lazily; or migrate to @angular/localize runtime XLIFF.

core_services.purpose: Centralized error normalization (returns AppError { message, code, details })
core_services.monitoring_integration: TODO — Sentry placeholder comment, not wired.

core_services.purpose: Sanitizes HTML, URLs, text, email, phone, address, notes, numbers, file names — defensive input cleanup before DB writes.

core_services.name: ConfirmationModalService

core_services.name: MobileShellTitleService
core_services.purpose: Allow detail pages (e.g. /property/:id) to override the mobile shell's green header title

core_services.name: ScrollRestoreService
core_services.purpose: Custom per-path scroll position cache for cross-route navigation, working both on window and on registered scroll host element (mobile vs desktop scroll model)

core_services.name: PropzaModalOptionsService
core_services.purpose: Returns NgbModalOptions presets — fullscreen sheet on mobile (<1024px), centered dialog on desktop

columns_runtime_authoritative.name: tenant
columns_runtime_authoritative.note: Set/cleared by TenantService.deleteTenant() to keep status pill in sync — redundant with tenants table

tables.name: payments

constraint_history.name: unique_property_period
constraint_history.dropped_in: 006_allow_partial_payments.sql (to allow multiple partial payments per period)

tables.note_owner_id: Settings export code queries payments WHERE owner_id = ... — but the schema has NO owner_id on payments. This will return zero rows and is a latent bug.

tables.purpose: Legacy tenancy model (start_date, end_date, rent_due_day). Still written/read by AddPropertyModalComponent and PropertyDetailComponent. Coexists with tenants table.

tables.name: profiles
tables.schema_source_migrations: NONE — table assumed to exist (likely via Supabase Auth trigger). RLS policies are created in 004 if it exists.

rls_policies.migration_004_authoritative: RLS policies tied to auth.uid() = owner_id (or via EXISTS on properties for tenants/payments/profiles).
rls_policies.earlier_001_003_policies_concern: Migrations 001 and 003 created permissive policies using only `auth.uid() IS NOT NULL` (any authenticated user could read all rows). 004 added correct owner-scoped policies but did NOT drop the older permissive ones. If both are active in production, RLS is effectively bypassable for SELECT.
rls_policies.remediation: Verify in production Supabase dashboard that only the migration-004 policies are enabled; drop any leftover legacy policies created by 001 or 003.

rpc_functions.name: delete_current_user
rpc_functions.expected_behavior: SECURITY DEFINER function that deletes the calling user from auth.users using auth.uid()
rpc_functions.note: Must be defined directly in Supabase dashboard. If missing, returns generic error caught and surfaced as toast.

storage_buckets.name: leases
storage_buckets.note: Bucket creation and access policies are configured in Supabase dashboard, not version-controlled.

external_services.name: Google OAuth
external_services.configured_via: Supabase Auth provider — code calls signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo: '/dashboard?beta=granted' } })

data_flows.name: Authentication (email/password)
steps: LoginComponent.submit() → AuthService.signInWithPassword(email, password)
Supabase Auth REST call
onAuthStateChange fires → session+user signals updated
Router.navigateByUrl('/dashboard')
authGuard re-runs on next navigation → user present → allow

data_flows.name: Authentication (Google OAuth)
steps: Login/Register .signInWithGoogle() → Supabase Auth signInWithOAuth (provider: google, redirectTo: /dashboard?beta=granted)
User redirected to Google → consent → back to /dashboard?beta=granted
Supabase auth callback parses URL hash (detectSessionInUrl: true)
?beta=granted query param hints app may also flip beta access (currently still requires localStorage flag set separately)

data_flows.name: Initial app boot
steps: main.ts → bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, appConfig)
AppComponent constructor → ThemeService.loadTheme() (waits for session, applies cached theme, syncs profiles.theme)
AppComponent.ngOnInit → AuthService.waitForSession() + (if user) navigate to /dashboard
Preloader shown for fixed 4000ms regardless of session resolution time

data_flows.name: Property list load
steps: PropertyListComponent.ngOnInit → combineLatest([properties$, payments$, loading$])
PropertyService.refreshAll() → loadProperties() + loadPayments()
Supabase: properties SELECT with nested tenants join, filtered by owner_id (RLS-enforced)
Supabase: payments SELECT WHERE property_id IN owned property IDs
Component computes per-property status via RentDueService.getStatusForTenant(...)
Filters/sort applied client-side, results rendered as PropertyCardComponent grid

data_flows.name: Payment write + status reconciliation
steps: PropertyDetailComponent.savePayment() collects current rent period via RentDueService.getCurrentPeriod()
INSERT into payments. On duplicate-period error code 23505 (legacy unique constraint), automatically advance to next period and retry, up to 12 attempts
PropertyService refresh triggered → payments$ emits
recalculateTenantStatusFromPayments() walks up to 12 months forward to find first unpaid period and updates tenants.rent_due_date + rent_status accordingly
TenantService.updateTenant() persists; PropertyService.loadProperties() refreshes

data_flows.name: Tenant deletion cascade
steps: TenantService.deleteTenant(id) → DELETE FROM tenants
Sets properties.status='vacant' and properties.tenant=null on the linked property
SupabaseService.triggerRefreshAll() → emits on refreshAll$
Both PropertyService.refreshAll() and TenantService.refreshTenants() fire automatically (they subscribe to refreshAll$)

data_flows.name: Theme sync
steps: ThemeService effect watches AuthService.user() signal
On login: read profiles.theme; if present and differs from current, apply + persist to localStorage
On user.setTheme(t): apply locally + UPDATE profiles.theme
Logout clears lastSyncedUserId

data_flows.name: Beta access gate
steps: betaAccessGuard runs before authGuard on protected routes
If environment.requiresBetaAccess=false → bypass entirely
Else check localStorage['propza_beta_access'] === 'granted'; redirect to /beta-access if missing
BetaAccessComponent collects 6 digits → btoa(code) === environment.betaAccessCodeHash → set localStorage flag → navigate to /login

data_flows.name: Add property + tenant + (optional) initial payment
steps: AddPropertyModalComponent.save() — validates required fields based on `occupied` checkbox
If occupied + leaseFile: upload to Supabase Storage bucket 'leases' at path {userId}/{ts}_{name}
INSERT properties { owner_id, name, address, rent_amount, status, currency='ZAR', lease_url }
If occupied: INSERT tenancies (legacy) and tenants (current model) with derived rent_status via RentDueService
If `currentlyPaid` checked: INSERT payments for current period (skips if already exists)
SupabaseService.triggerRefreshAll() → all services refresh

data_flows.name: Data export
steps: Settings → Export My Data → parallel SELECT * FROM properties|payments|tenancies (scoped by owner_id, except payments which uses owner_id that DOES NOT EXIST on payments — see latent bug)
JSON.stringify + Blob download as propza-export.json

data_flows.name: Account deletion
steps: DeleteAccountModalComponent collects confirmation text 'delete' + checkbox
AuthService.deleteAccount() → supabase.rpc('delete_current_user')
If success → signOut → navigate to /register

constraints: Billing is monthly-only in current product surface (RentDueService); RentHelperService retains weekly helpers as dead/parallel code.
Currency is hard-coded to ZAR throughout (Intl.NumberFormat 'en-ZA', 'currency: ZAR').
Timezone is hard-coded to UTC+2 (Africa/Johannesburg) — no DST handling needed for ZA.
All Angular components must be standalone — no NgModules allowed.
No NgModules → all imports via standalone components' imports array.
Bundle budgets: initial warn 2MB / error 3MB, anyComponentStyle warn 15kB / error 25kB.

No backend API exists — all data operations go directly from the browser to Supabase. Logic that cannot be client-side (e.g. account deletion, mass scheduled jobs) must live as Postgres RPC functions.
Auth state is the source of truth in signals; older RxJS BehaviorSubjects in PropertyService/TenantService should not be mixed with signals in templates without takeUntilDestroyed/async pipe.
Sensitive operations rely on Supabase RLS — any new table must enable RLS and add owner-scoped policies.
All user input passed to Supabase must go through SanitizationService.
Mobile/desktop split for Settings is component-level (separate component trees) — not just CSS.
Detail views (property/:id, tenant/:id) use router state 'backUrl' for back-button context. ScrollRestoreService caches positions per cleanPath.
Toast service expects all toasts to be created via show()/success()/error()/warning()/info().
Confirmation modals: use ConfirmationModalService.confirm() (returns Promise<boolean>) instead of window.confirm.

architectural_issues.title: Schema drift between migrations and runtime
architectural_issues.description: Migration 001_properties_table.sql declares status IN ('available','occupied','maintenance') with rent_frequency, bedrooms, bathrooms, size_sqm, property_type, and rent_amount INTEGER. Runtime uses status IN ('vacant','occupied'), references owner_id, name, currency, lease_url, tenant — none present in the migration. The tenants migration omits deposit_amount which is read/written by the app. The tenancies and profiles tables are used heavily but have NO migration in the repo.
architectural_issues.impact: Anyone re-creating the project from migrations cannot run the app. New developers cannot trust the SQL files. Future migrations risk conflicting with hand-applied changes.
architectural_issues.remediation: Add migrations 008+: drop legacy properties columns, add owner_id/name/currency/lease_url/tenant/notes, alter status check, create profiles table with id+full_name+theme+notifications_enabled, create tenancies table (or deprecate), alter tenants to add deposit_amount.

architectural_issues.title: Stale, permissive RLS policies likely still active
architectural_issues.description: Migrations 001 and 003 created RLS policies using only `auth.uid() IS NOT NULL`, meaning every authenticated user could read every row. Migration 004 created correct owner-scoped policies but never DROP'd the old ones. Postgres evaluates policies as OR — if both sets exist, the permissive ones win.
architectural_issues.impact: Potential tenant-data leakage across customers if the permissive policies were ever applied to production.
architectural_issues.remediation: Run `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can view their own properties" ON properties; DROP POLICY ... "Users can insert their own properties" ...` etc. for every legacy policy. Verify with `SELECT * FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public'`.

architectural_issues.title: Beta access gate is trivially bypassable
architectural_issues.description: BetaAccessService uses btoa() (base64 encoding) — labeled 'hash' — and stores the result in localStorage. Anyone can run `localStorage.setItem('propza_beta_access','granted')` in DevTools, or reverse atob() the hash.
architectural_issues.impact: Beta gate is friction-only, not security. Acceptable IF that's intentional; dangerous if treated as access control.
architectural_issues.remediation: If gate is truly intended as access control: move validation server-side (Supabase RPC) or rely on Supabase auth allow-lists. Otherwise, rename 'hash' to 'code' and document it as soft friction.

architectural_issues.title: Dev credentials hard-coded and committed
architectural_issues.description: scripts/replace-env-vars.js inlines `https://szmsslujuqdrsgogzaaw.supabase.co` and a JWT anon key as the dev fallback. These ship in the public repo.
architectural_issues.impact: Project URL and anon key are public. The anon key is low-impact by Supabase design (subject to RLS), but coupling makes accidental promotion to other envs easier and is poor hygiene.
architectural_issues.remediation: Remove hard-coded fallbacks, fail loudly if NG_APP_* are missing, document required local setup in README.

architectural_issues.title: Two overlapping rent-status services
architectural_issues.description: RentDueService (monthly-only, ZA TZ-safe, comprehensive) and RentHelperService (monthly+weekly, older). Components mix both — some call only RentHelper, some only RentDue, some both. PropertyDetail and TenantDetail components carry per-component map functions converting TenantStatus → RentStatus.
architectural_issues.impact: Inconsistency risk in rent status displayed across screens; double the surface area to maintain.
architectural_issues.remediation: Consolidate into a single RentService. Move all status enums, label/color maps, period helpers into one module. Delete the weekly branch from RentHelper if monthly is the contract.

architectural_issues.title: Direct Supabase calls from components
architectural_issues.description: PropertyDetailComponent, TenantDetailComponent, AddPropertyModalComponent, AddTenantModalComponent and both Settings components call `supabase.supabase.from('tenancies'|'tenants'|'payments'|'profiles')` directly, instead of routing through PropertyService/TenantService.
architectural_issues.impact: Side effects bypass the service-level cache and refresh choreography. Easy to introduce drift between observable state and actual DB rows. Hard to unit-test components.
architectural_issues.remediation: Add the missing service methods (e.g. ProfileService for profiles, TenancyService or merge into TenantService). Forbid `supabase.from(...)` outside core/services via a lint rule.

architectural_issues.title: All routes eagerly loaded
architectural_issues.description: app.routes.ts statically imports every page component including settings (mobile+desktop), property detail, tenant detail, payments, dashboard, auth pages, all settings modals.
architectural_issues.impact: Inflated initial bundle. Already hitting the 2MB warning budget (ng-bootstrap + Bootstrap + Lottie are heavy).
architectural_issues.remediation: Switch each top-level route to `loadComponent: () => import('./...').then(m => m.X)`. Especially: settings split, all settings modals (open via NgbModal — can be lazy via dynamic import), tenant/property detail.

architectural_issues.title: Latent bug: payments.owner_id does not exist
architectural_issues.description: SettingsDesktopComponent.exportMyData() and SettingsMobileComponent.exportMyData() query `payments.eq('owner_id', user.id)`. The payments table has no owner_id column (RLS scopes via property_id → owner_id join).
architectural_issues.impact: Export returns zero payments. Silent data loss in the user export feature.
architectural_issues.remediation: Either add owner_id (denormalized) to payments and backfill, or change the query to `.in('property_id', userPropertyIds)` (the same pattern PropertyService.loadPayments uses).

architectural_issues.title: Legacy tenancies table coexists with tenants
architectural_issues.description: Both `tenancies` (with start_date, end_date, rent_due_day) and `tenants` (with lease_start_date, lease_end_date, rent_due_date) are written by AddPropertyModalComponent and deleted by PropertyDetailComponent/TenantService. Status calculations now use only tenants.
architectural_issues.impact: Double-writes risk inconsistency. Reads from tenancies are mostly dead but still occur (PropertyDetail loadPropertyDetails).
architectural_issues.remediation: Migrate any remaining tenancies reads to tenants, then drop the table and remove insert paths.

architectural_issues.title: Profiles table not provisioned by repo
architectural_issues.description: AuthService, ThemeService, AuthenticatedShellComponent, Settings all SELECT/UPDATE `profiles` (id, full_name, theme, notifications_enabled). No migration creates the table or its RLS row creation trigger. 004 adds policies only `IF EXISTS`.
architectural_issues.impact: Fresh Supabase project will silently 404/error on profile queries. New developers can't reproduce locally.
architectural_issues.remediation: Add migration: CREATE TABLE public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users, full_name text, theme text CHECK (theme IN ('light','dark')) DEFAULT 'light', notifications_enabled boolean DEFAULT false). Add trigger on auth.users insert to bootstrap a profile row.

architectural_issues.title: Translation file is monolithic (1828 lines)
architectural_issues.description: Single object literal in translation.service.ts holds all four languages and every UI string. Adds to JS bundle even for users on a single language.
architectural_issues.remediation: Split into per-language JSON loaded via fetch, or migrate to @angular/localize XLIFF compile-time translations.

architectural_issues.title: Hard-coded 4-second preloader
architectural_issues.description: AppComponent uses setTimeout(4000) to dismiss the preloader regardless of how fast the app boots. Causes UX delay on fast networks.
architectural_issues.remediation: Dismiss as soon as `auth.waitForSession()` resolves OR after a minimum (e.g. 800ms) — whichever is later.

architectural_issues.title: Console suppression in main.ts hides errors
architectural_issues.description: main.ts overrides console.error to filter Navigator LockManager + apple-mobile-web-app-capable warnings. Pattern can mask other errors and complicates debugging.
architectural_issues.remediation: Use Supabase client option `debug: false` (already done) and remove the global console wrapper. Address the apple-mobile-web-app-capable deprecation in index.html (use `mobile-web-app-capable` only).

architectural_issues.title: Storage bucket policies are not version-controlled
architectural_issues.description: `leases` bucket is required for AddPropertyModal/AddTenantModal but no SQL/policy file exists.
architectural_issues.remediation: Add a migration that creates the bucket and policies via `storage.create_bucket` and INSERT into `storage.policies` (or document via supabase config).

architectural_issues.title: No CI/error monitoring
architectural_issues.description: No GitHub Actions, no Sentry, no test coverage gate. Specs are scaffolds.
architectural_issues.remediation: Add a minimal CI (lint + build + ng test --no-watch --code-coverage). Wire Sentry into ErrorService.handleError().

architectural_issues.title: ng-bootstrap + Bootstrap + Tailwind together
architectural_issues.description: Three CSS systems load simultaneously (ng-bootstrap requires Bootstrap CSS, Tailwind provides utility classes, plus per-component SCSS). Bootstrap CSS alone is ~150 KB minified.
architectural_issues.remediation: If Tailwind is the design system going forward, replace ng-bootstrap modal/popover with headless Angular CDK Overlay equivalents and drop Bootstrap CSS.

architectural_issues.title: Two settings components instead of responsive single
architectural_issues.description: SettingsComponent picks between SettingsDesktopComponent (385 LOC) and SettingsMobileComponent (1145 LOC). Both implement the same features twice. SettingsMobile carries extensive scroll-restoration debug scaffolding.
architectural_issues.remediation: Long-term: unify into one component driven by CSS responsive design and minimal feature flags. Short-term: extract shared logic (loadProfile, modal openers, exportMyData) into a SettingsCoreService.

architecture_decisions.decision: No separate backend — Angular SPA talks to Supabase directly.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Faster iteration; offload auth/db/storage to a managed BaaS; PWA-friendly because all logic runs client-side.
Smaller per-route bundles, simpler dependency graph, aligns with Angular team's recommended direction.

architecture_decisions.decision: Hybrid state: Signals for auth/theme/UI state, BehaviorSubjects for collections (properties, tenants, payments).
architecture_decisions.rationale: Signals work well for primitives consumed in templates with autotracking. BehaviorSubjects integrate cleanly with combineLatest for derived dashboard views.
Avoids services needing to know about each other while still letting one mutation (e.g. delete tenant) trigger fan-out refreshes.

architecture_decisions.decision: Custom translation service instead of @angular/localize compile-time i18n.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Runtime language switching without separate language builds. Cost: heavier translation bundle.

architecture_decisions.decision: Custom static dev server (scripts/dev-server.js) at port 4201 instead of `ng serve`.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Tests the production-style bundle locally (same code path as Vercel).

architecture_decisions.decision: All routes eagerly loaded in a single flat routes file.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Simpler to reason about. (Cost: see ISSUE-007.)

architecture_decisions.decision: RentDueService is the authoritative pure-function status engine (monthly, ZA timezone).
architecture_decisions.rationale: Centralize fragile date math. RentHelperService remains for backward compatibility but should be deprecated.

architecture_decisions.decision: Per-component SCSS plus Tailwind utility classes.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Component encapsulation for complex layouts, Tailwind for fast prototyping. Tailwind theme.extend.colors maps CSS variables for dark theme.

architecture_decisions.decision: View transitions enabled at the router level (withViewTransitions).

architecture_decisions.rationale: Avoid stale assets during local development.

build_targets.development: ng build --configuration development (no optimization, source maps)
build_targets.production: ng build --configuration production (optimization, namedChunks off, service worker on, file replacement of environment.ts with environment.prod.ts)

agent_navigation_hints.where_to_add_a_new_page: src/app/features/<feature>/pages/<page>/, then register in src/app/app.routes.ts inside the AuthenticatedShellComponent children array (or top level if public). Set data.mobileShellTitle.
agent_navigation_hints.where_to_add_a_new_service: src/app/core/services/<name>.service.ts with @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }). If it owns a collection, expose properties$/loading$ BehaviorSubjects AND subscribe to SupabaseService.refreshAll$.
agent_navigation_hints.where_to_add_a_new_supabase_table: Add SQL migration in supabase-migrations/00X_<name>.sql, ALWAYS enable RLS and add owner-scoped SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies. Add TS model in src/app/core/models/, export from src/app/core/models/index.ts.
agent_navigation_hints.where_to_add_a_new_translation: src/app/core/services/translation.service.ts — add key with all four languages (en, af, zu, xh).
agent_navigation_hints.where_to_change_theme_tokens: tailwind.config.js (theme.extend.colors uses CSS variables) + src/styles.scss for the actual variable definitions (dark vs light).
agent_navigation_hints.how_to_open_a_modal: Inject NgbModal + PropzaModalOptionsService; call this.modal.open(MyComponent, this.modalOptions.createEntityFlow()) for forms, or .authAuxiliaryModal() for small dialogs.
agent_navigation_hints.how_to_confirm_an_action: Inject ConfirmationModalService; `const ok = await this.confirmationService.confirm({ title, message, type: 'danger' });`.
agent_navigation_hints.how_to_run_locally: Set NG_APP_* in .env.local (see env.example), then `npm run start` (dev build + static serve on :4201). Use `npm run kill` to free the port.
agent_navigation_hints.how_to_deploy: Push to a Vercel-integrated branch. Vercel runs `npm run build:vercel` which generates env files then `ng build --configuration production`. Output: dist/propza/browser. SPA rewrites set in vercel.json.
